_doc: Hoenn's warp-only outdoor maps (no walking connection to the main matrix), built by b2tools/world.py on their own matrices the way Black 2 builds separate outdoor areas (one matrix per group, appended after the Hoenn matrix by patches/hoenn_world.py in this order). 'maps': map -> [x, z] tile position inside the group (Safari Zone: Sapphire's own connections). The group is cut to whole cells around its walkable tiles plus 'margin' tiles [west/east, north, south] (what Gen 5's camera can see; no ring cells); 'align': a group tile that must land on a cell corner (the Safari Zone's map seams, so each area's cells are its own zone). 'border': what fills the cells around the map, as Sapphire's border blocks do beyond a map's edge: 'forest' (world.py's trees), 'sapphire' (the layout's own border metatiles, classified like the map's tiles), or a plan class for every outside tile ('cliff_top' rock, 'water' sea). 'retile': {class: new class} for Sapphire metatiles listed in 'retile_metatiles' (e.g. Mt. Pyre summit's sky tiles, labelled water). 'area': the exterior area record the group's zones use (patches/hoenn_world.py copies area 3, Hoenn's summer area, into it; patches/standalone.py gives it its own building pack). Warps: every Sapphire warp of these maps is an appended door of its zone in Sapphire's order (index = the zone's Black 2 warp count + Sapphire warp id), so rooms, caves and the other maps name Sapphire's dest_warp_id.
_build_doc: 'build': the groups b2tools/world.py builds ('all' or a list; the env HOENN_STANDALONE overrides it). Empty: none, and the main matrix is built exactly as before (Routes 104/112's doors to the woods and Jagged Pass lead nowhere). Turn on after build_rom.py's RESERVE[8] has room for their chunks (~2.2 MB, measured by world.py's report) and with the 'standalone' patch in the build's patch list. (events agent, 2026-10-07: 'build' lists the groups built before the event islands; the five event-island groups (FarawayIsland_*, BirthIsland_Exterior, NavelRock_*) build with HOENN_STANDALONE=all until RESERVE[8] has room for them: then set 'build' back to 'all'.)
_bgm_doc: 'bgm_zone': the Black 2 zone whose music (4 seasons) the group's zones play, for Sapphire's track: MUS_PETALBURG_WOODS -> Pinwheel Forest's inner forest (155, D_01), MUS_MT_CHIMNEY -> Reversal Mountain's volcano (461, SW_KAZAN), MUS_MT_PYRE_EXTERIOR -> Dragonspiral/Celestial Tower (206, D_05), MUS_SAFARI_ZONE -> Floccesy Ranch (445, SW_D_22), MUS_ABANDONED_SHIP (Southern Island) -> Lostlorn Forest (385, D_06), MUS_SOOTOPOLIS -> Humilau City (465, SW_C_14), MUS_B_TOWER -> the PWT lobby (192, WBT_LOBBY). 'effect': the zone header's transition effect (default 1 = indoor: black fades, no season wipe; 3 = cave: fades to white when leaving; see patches/hoenn_world.py). Event islands (Emerald): MUS_ABANDONED_SHIP (Faraway Island) -> Lostlorn Forest (385) like Southern Island; MUS_NONE (Birth Island) -> Black 2's silent field track (zone 145's SEQ_BGM_SILENCE_FIELD); MUS_RG_SEVII_ROUTE (Navel Rock outside) -> Route 13 (370); MUS_RG_SEVII_CAVE (Navel Rock's summit and caves) -> Seaside Cave (515).
_look_doc: Look options (b2tools/world.py build_cell, GROUP): 'retex': {texture: stand-in} renames the terrain's textures in the group's cells (Black 2's own variants: Lentimas/Reversal Mountain's red volcanic rock for Mt. Chimney and Jagged Pass, Opelucid's grey stone walls and Route 23's cobbles for Sootopolis's white stone); 'ground': {tile class: texture, 'default': texture} the ground texture by class; 'path_as_ground': paths are drawn as that ground (Sootopolis's paved terraces, Sky Pillar's floor); 'lava': the texture of tiles retiled to class 'lava' (Mt. Chimney's crater, Reversal Mountain's magma), drawn flat and solid; 'textures': every stand-in -> its Black 2 map texture set (a/0/1/4), merged into the area's own set by patches/standalone.py. 'clamp_south': N lowers unwalkable scenery less than N rows south of walkable ground to that ground's height (world.py clamp_south: Mt. Chimney's plaza). 'lava_top', 'lava_bank', 'lava_shore': Reversal Mountain's crust (in81_magu01), bank (in81_mizuga1) and shore (in81_mizugiwa) round the lava (world.py lava_tile: the lava 10 under the ground, banks sloping into it; buildings_audit 2026-10-08). 'area': the group's own area record instead of the shared one (a Black 2 area no zone uses: 407 for Mt. Chimney), 'srt_anim': its terrain SRT animation (a/0/6/8 entry; 29 = Reversal Mountain's, which scrolls in81_magu00/01 and in81_mizugiwa: the lava moves), written by patches/standalone.py.
